title: IBGE Exam Releases Cards and Test Venues for Temporary Positions
seoTitle: IBGE Exam: Test Venues Released for Temporary Roles
subtitle: Candidates can now check the schedules and locations for tests scheduled for next Sunday.
excerpt: IBGE exam candidates can now check their test venues for temporary positions. The release was made available on the Instituto Avalia website.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Blog Gran Cursos Online, Degrau Cultural, Qconcursos Folha Dirigida
contentHtml:
Candidates registered for the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics selection process can now view their information cards containing the test venues. The release took place on the portal of Instituto Avalia, the organizing committee responsible for 1,414 temporary positions in the selection process.

Checking Test Venues and Details

The Candidate Information Card provides details such as the test venue address, time, and testing room. The document became available on the organizer's portal starting at 4 PM. The exams are confirmed to take place next Sunday, August 30, in all state capitals across the country and in the Federal District.

The objective tests will be administered in different shifts: in the morning for census quality agents and in the afternoon for census analysts. Participants are advised to arrive at the venue at least 60 minutes before the scheduled time for gate closures.

Candidate-to-Seat Ratio and Number of Applicants

The selection process registered a total of 89,672 applicants for the positions organized by the board. The census quality agent position accounts for 52,837 registrations for 394 opportunities. Meanwhile, the census analyst role has 36,835 candidates competing for 1,020 positions across various fields of knowledge.

In the state of Rio de Janeiro, the total number of applicants reaches 17,962, divided between high school and higher education opportunities. The competition per vacancy varies according to the municipality of choice and the function selected by the participant.

Structure of the Objective Evaluation

The objective test will last for four hours and will consist of 60 multiple-choice questions with five alternatives and only one correct answer. To be considered approved, the candidate must answer at least one question from each subject and achieve the minimum performance required by the notice, which is 30% for census quality agents and 40% for census analysts.

What to Bring on Exam Day

On the day of the evaluation, participants must bring an official original photo ID, a blue or black ballpoint pen made of transparent material, and the printed information card. Correctly identifying the test venue is solely the candidate's responsibility.

With information from Blog Gran Cursos Online, Degrau Cultural, Qconcursos Folha Dirigida.
